what: One black stage is pinned to the screen and plays several chapters in turn over a long scroll (16000px by default) — the opening text holds for 10 units then disappears over 5, each chapter rests 5 units, the video plate grows from a point (0×) to full size over 5 units (circ.out), the overlapping cutout over 2, and 1 unit later the title turns on over 2. After holding 5 units the video swells to 3× and vanishes over 5, the cutout and title overlap by 1 and turn off over 2, then on to the next chapter — tied to scroll, so it rewinds

duration.Share: Scroll length divided by the total share (15 + 27 per chapter)

options.[data-fx-part=intro]: Hero headline (child, selector) — holds for 10 parts, then fades out over 5 parts
options.[data-fx-part=chapter]: Chapter (child, multiple) — a cell that fills the stage. Contains film · layer · title
options.[data-fx-part=film]: Video panel in a chapter — scales from 0 to 1x, then swells to 3x and vanishes
options.[data-fx-part=title]: Title and keywords inside the chapter (pick)
options.ease: Curve, default circ.out (GSAP name or the 0.16,1,0.3,1 form)
options.rest: Pause before growing and swelling (share), default 5 — the first one holds twice as long

use:
Chapter

01
note: A chapter is display:none when it is not its turn, so it is not drawn while the video is hidden. With reduced motion, the first chapter is shown fully and held still
